name: Blog to CMS (canonical shape → Webflow or WordPress)

nodes.name: Read blog briefs (Sheet)
nodes.notes: One row per post. Columns: topic, optional title, slug, etc. Add filters (e.g. status=ready) if needed. See README-blog-to-cms.md.

nodes.name: Generate content (add OpenAI/LLM node)
nodes.notes: Swap for OpenAI/LLM node: input = sheet row (topic etc), output = canonical blog fields. See docs/CONTENT-CANONICAL-SCHEMAS.md.

nodes.name: Normalize to canonical blog
nodes.notes: Canonical shape per docs/CONTENT-CANONICAL-SCHEMAS.md. Next node = CMS adapter (Webflow or WordPress).

nodes.name: HTTP Request (CMS adapter)
nodes.notes: Webflow example. For WordPress: POST /wp/v2/posts with body mapping per CONTENT-CANONICAL-SCHEMAS. Swap URL and body for your CMS.
